My grandmother kept her recipes on index cards in a shoebox, half of them stained with butter and missing steps she assumed you'd already know. The pie crust card just says "cold everything" and "don't overwork it," which is either wisdom or a trap, depending on how your afternoon goes.

I tried making it last weekend. Overworked it anyway. The crust came out tough around the edges but fine in the middle, so we ate it and didn't say much about the edges.

She would have laughed and told me to try again next month. That's basically the whole story.
